'''''Medicago scutellata''''' is a plant species of the genus ''[[Medicago]]''. It is found throughout the Mediterranean basin. It forms a [[symbiosis|symbiotic]] relationship with the bacterium ''[[Sinorhizobium meliloti]]'', which is capable of [[nitrogen fixation]]. Common names include '''snail medick'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref><ref>{{PLANTS|id=MESC6|taxon=Medicago scutellata|accessdate=28 January 2016}}</ref> and '''shield medick'''.
